text:
sylvia_marketing: Heads up — DeepHarbor customer story. Need to lock interview, transcript, and rights by EOD Thu so we can hit next-week launch. Customer availability: Mon–Wed next week, CET. Who can own recording + transcript + quote approvals?

 tim_se: I can own the technical interview. Prefer Mon 18:00 CET (that’s Tue 9am PT). Will pull P50/P95 graphs and a short before/after perf blurb. @lisa_editor can you do transcript + quote drafts?

 lisa_editor: Yep, I’ll transcribe with Otter, do a first-pass edit, and prep 2 quote options (short/long). Qs: can we publish exact latency numbers? Do they want an embargo?

 ana_prod: Customer mentioned a 1-week embargo is fine. Latency numbers need legal sign-off before we publish — tagging @marc_legal for review.

 marc_legal: Marc (Legal) here — we need: the exact phrasing for any latency/ops numbers, a signed testimonial release, and the customer contact to send the release to. Prefer attribution for metrics (e.g., "P95 latency reduced from X to Y as measured by Redwood telemetry"). If they won’t sign off on raw P50/P95, we should use qualitative language.

 jamie_ops: Scheduling note: Zoom + recording ok. I’ll create the meeting and enable recording and captions. Tentative slot set for Mon 18:00 CET — will confirm with customer.

 sylvia_marketing: Thanks. For interview flow please focus on: 1) prior infra pain, 2) specific metric improvements (cost/latency), 3) day-to-day ops change. Use this quote prompt: "How has Redwood changed your inference performance and ops overhead? Any concrete before/after numbers or specific workflows it simplified?" Keep answers short — we’ll craft 1-sentence and paragraph options.

 lisa_editor: After the call I’ll produce: 1) two quote variants, 2) a 150-word case blurb, 3) recommended pull quotes for social. Also need localization for ES/DE microcopies — @ana_loc can you estimate turnaround?

 ana_loc: I can localize Spanish and German microcopy. Need a glossary for product terms and preferred translations. Please post the glossary doc link in thread (or use https://redwood.internal/docs/glossary). ETA for both: 48 hours after final copy.

 tim_se: I’ll attach dashboard screenshots and export the p95 graph as PNG during the call. Also preparing a 2-paragraph technical appendix describing model variants and routing policy used for the benchmark.

 marc_legal: Uploaded a redlined testimonial release to Drive: https://drive.redwood.company/DeepHarbor-release-redline. Please review. If customer refuses numeric detail, language fallback: "significant reduction in latency and cost" — but we still need a signed release for any quote.

 sylvia_marketing: Checklist I’ll track: 1) confirm recording slot + calendar invite, 2) record call + screenshots, 3) transcribe and draft quotes, 4) send release to customer + get signature, 5) final copy -> localization -> schedule social + webinar mention. I’ll ping the customer now.

 jamie_ops: Invite sent to customer (DeepHarbor contact: marie@deepharbor.ai). Zoom link in calendar. Recording enabled.

 lisa_editor: Great — I’ll start the transcript after the meeting and drop quote options in this thread. Target: Wed EOD for final drafts so marketing can prep landing + webinar mention.

 sylvia_marketing: Awesome, team. Small note: if legal needs extra time, we’ll move embargo accordingly. Thanks :rocket:
